task.question: What is the median overall survival time reported for patients with metastatic pancreatic cancer in May 2026?
task.evidence: 31 May – A Phase 3 trial published in the New England Journal of Medicine reports that daraxonrasib, an investigational oral RAS(ON) inhibitor, nearly doubles median overall survival in patients with previously treated metastatic pancreatic cancer, from 6.6 months with standard chemotherapy to 13.2 months.

answer: FINAL: According to a Phase 3 trial published in the New England Journal of Medicine on May 31, 2026, the median overall survival time for patients with previously treated metastatic pancreatic cancer receiving daraxonrasib (a RAS inhibitor) was 13.2 months, compared to 6.6 months with standard chemotherapy.
final: According to a Phase 3 trial published in the New England Journal of Medicine on May 31, 2026, the median overall survival time for patients with previously treated metastatic pancreatic cancer receiving daraxonrasib (a RAS inhibitor) was 13.2 months, compared to 6.6 months with standard chemotherapy.
